sources.title: The Jets are considering two veteran starting quarterbacks per reports
sources.description: The Jets need to find a starting quarterback in 2026. There aren’t many quality options on the market. However, over the last few days a pair of teams announced they were moving on from big money veteran starting quarterbacks.
